what_worked: Coherent thesis arc from market selection through growth to exits, with consistent takeaway structure.
fix_next: Replace generic advice slides with actual charts, numbers, and sourced data points from the dataset—most slides are unsupported assertions.
verdict: Motivational startup guide with thin data backing and multiple factual errors.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: 'Sales' is not a dataset category; median MRR figures for Marketing ($1,586 vs ref $2,369.50) and Education ($2,142 vs ref $2,435) are wrong; AI at '20% of all startups' is 197/726≈27% of categorized or 197/1000≈20% of total—ambiguous denominator. Slide 4: 'Sales Software' median $2,153 has no matching category; Productivity median $42 vs ref $79.91. Slide 5: B2B median $1,036 and B2C $181 don't match reference medians; '5.7x' ratio is inconsistent with stated numbers (1036/181≈5.7x but reference median multiples are ~2.3x). Slide 10: 'Domain authority is the strongest revenue predictor' is an unsupported causal claim not verifiable from the dataset. Slide 13: '26% actively acquired or for sale' is unverifiable from reference data.

evidence.insight: Most slides offer generic startup advice (choose B2B, price for value, build MRR) that could apply to any dataset. No original analytical finding goes beyond surface-level category comparisons. Slide 7 claims '250x more per customer' with zero supporting data shown.
evidence.narrative: There is a clear six-section structure (choose business → customer → model → reach → growth → exit) with a consistent 'Key Takeaway' format. However, the sequence reads as a startup advice listicle rather than a data-driven story with a synthesized argument.
evidence.framing: No dataset description, sample size, time period, or methodology is ever mentioned. A cold reader would not know this is based on a 1,000-company dataset. No limitations or missingness acknowledged. Audience is implied (aspiring founders) but never stated.
evidence.accuracy: Multiple median figures don't match reference data. 'Sales' and 'Sales Software' are not dataset categories. B2B/B2C multiplier claimed as 5.7x contradicts reference ~2.3x median multiple. Marketing median off by ~$783. Education median off by ~$293. Causal language on slide 10 ('generates,' 'strongest predictor') is unsupported.
evidence.visual: Gamma template with uniform dark backgrounds, purple accent bars, and decorative AI-generated illustrations (slides 1, 14, 15). No actual data visualizations—no bar charts, scatter plots, or distributions. The iceberg graphic on slide 12 is decorative, not data-mapped. Repetitive layout across nearly every slide.
evidence.ai_slop: Heavy template repetition: every slide has identical 'Key Takeaway' purple bar. Decorative AI illustrations on slides 1, 14, 15 add no analytical value. Slide 6 roadmap infographic is generic MRR explainer. Slide 15 is pure motivational filler. 'Sales Software' appears to be a fabricated category name.
